description.p: driftwave is a terminal music player for SoundCloud. Search tracks, artists, albums and playlists, browse an artist's whole catalog, and listen in AAC with a live spectrum visualizer.

ul.li: Instant streaming with a queue, shuffle, repeat and endless radio
Browse any genre or tag, with related tags to keep exploring
Lyrics that follow the song (LRCLIB, Genius as a fallback), in a pop-out window too
Album art, media keys and desktop notifications
A library folder for lyrics, covers and official downloads
Full mouse support; no account needed

screenshot.caption: Player with album art and visualizer
Synced lyrics that follow the song

description.p: Go+ preview tracks now play: the full song from another upload when there is one, otherwise the 30-second preview. Stricter matching so remixes and edits are never picked as replacements.
Volume now matches how loud it sounds (50% is about half as loud), and KDE's media widget volume syncs both ways.
